units.source_text: 尼姑母夫人是个深思远虑的人，对女儿说道：“你这种顾虑毫无道理！

en.t: The nun's mother was a woman of deep foresight, and she said to her daughter, "This anxiety of yours has no reason at all!

units.source_text: 你今后见不到这孩子，也许痛苦甚多，但你应该为这孩子的利益着想。

en.t: You may suffer greatly because you will no longer see this child, but you ought to think of what is best for her.

units.source_text: 公子定是再三考虑之后才对你宣说的。

en.t: The gentleman must have spoken to you only after thinking it over again and again.

units.source_text: 你只管信赖他，将孩子送过去吧。

en.t: Simply trust him, and send the child to him.

units.source_text: 你看：皇帝的儿子，也根据母亲的身份而有高下之别。

en.t: Consider this: even an emperor's sons differ in rank according to their mother's status.

units.source_text: 就像这位源氏内大臣，人品虽然盖世无双，但终于降为臣籍，不得身为亲王，只能当个朝廷命官。

en.t: Take this Genji Minister of the Center: though his character is without equal in the world, he was finally reduced to subject status, unable to remain an imperial prince, and could only become an official of the court.

units.source_text: 何以故？

en.t: Why was that?

units.source_text: 只因他的外公——已故的按察大纳言——官位比别的女御的父亲低一级，

en.t: Simply because his maternal grandfather, the late Azechi Dainagon, held a rank one step lower than the fathers of the other imperial consorts,

units.source_text: 所以他母亲只能当个更衣，而他就被人称为更衣生的皇子，差别就在于此啊！

en.t: his mother could only become a lesser consort, and he was called a prince born of a lesser consort. That is where the distinction lies!

units.source_text: 皇帝的儿子尚且如此，何况一般臣下，更不可相提并论了。

en.t: If even an emperor's son is treated so, then ordinary subjects can hardly be compared at all.

units.source_text: 再就一般家庭而言，同是亲王或大臣的女儿，

en.t: And speaking of ordinary households, even among daughters of princes or ministers,

units.source_text: 但倘这亲王或大臣官位较低，这女儿又非正夫人，

en.t: if that prince or minister holds a lower rank, and if the daughter is not the principal wife,

units.source_text: 她所生之子女就为人所轻视，父亲对这子女的待遇也就不同。

en.t: then the children she bears are looked down upon, and their father treats them differently as well.

units.source_text: 何况我们这种人家，如果公子的别的夫人中有一个身份高于我们的人生了子女，

en.t: How much more so for a family like ours: if one of the gentleman's other wives, someone of higher status than we are, were to bear a child,

units.source_text: 那么我们这孩子就全被压倒了。

en.t: then our child would be completely overshadowed.

units.source_text: 再说，凡女子不论身份高下，能得双亲重视，便是受人尊敬的起因。

en.t: Besides, for any girl, whatever her rank, being valued by both parents is the source of others' respect.

units.source_text: 这孩子的穿裙仪式，倘由我们举行，

en.t: If we were to hold this child's skirt-wearing ceremony ourselves,

units.source_text: 即使尽心竭力，在这深山僻处有何体面可言？

en.t: even if we put all our hearts into it, what dignity could there be in this remote mountain place?

units.source_text: 终不如完全交给他们，看他们如何排场。”

en.t: In the end, it would be better to leave everything to them and see how splendidly they arrange it."

units.source_text: 她把女儿教训了一番之后，又与见解高明之人商量，

en.t: After admonishing her daughter in this way, she also consulted people of sound judgment,

units.source_text: 再请算命先生卜筮，都说送二条院大吉。

en.t: and then had diviners cast fortunes; all said that sending the child to Nijo-in would be greatly auspicious.

units.source_text: 明石姬的心也就软下来了。

en.t: Akashi Lady's heart then softened as well.
